title: ‘Trump is killing poor people’: relatives mourn man killed in US military strike in Caribbean
summary: Relatives of Trinidadian man believed killed in US military strike on alleged drug boat say he was denied due process Relatives of two men from Trinidad believed to have been killed in a US military strike on boat in the Caribbean have accused Donald Trump of “killing poor people” without due process and are demanding justice. Chad “Charpo” Joseph and Rishi Samaroo, from the fishing village of Las Cuevas in northern Trinidad, are thought to be among six people killed in a US airstrike on a boat allegedly transporting drugs from Venezuela . title: Manchester bomber’s brother pleads not guilty to attempted murders in jail
summary: Hashem Abedi on trial at Old Bailey over ‘terrorist’ attacks on three prison officers with hot oil and makeshift weapons The brother of the Manchester Arena bomber has pleaded not guilty to carrying out “terrorist” attacks on prison officers at a maximum-security jail with hot cooking oil and makeshift weapons. Hashem Abedi, 28, appeared at the Old Bailey on Friday by video link from HMP Belmarsh in south-east London. The prosecutor Jocelyn Ledward KC said the case had a terrorist connection and taken place during “a session where he was permitted to use cooking equipment”. Continue reading...

title: Trump to pay Ice and border agents amid shutdown as other federal workers go unpaid
summary: Administration reportedly promises ‘supercheck’ covering shutdown pay for law enforcement officers across DHS The Trump administration has promised tens of thousands of federal agents carrying out his immigration crackdown that they will be paid during the government shutdown , according to emails seen by Reuters, even as other federal workers go without pay.
